name: H00_crow_dies_mills_its_controllers_library_not_its_owners
note: Crow of Dark Tidings: 'mill two cards' puts the top two cards of the library of the player who controls the ability. P0 owns the Crow but P1 controls it (gain_control) when it dies: the dies trigger is P1's, so P1's top two cards go to P1's graveyard and P0's library is untouched; the Crow card itself goes to its owner P0's graveyard.
